## Walkthrough

Phase 15 Day 3 frontend polish and accessibility initiative delivering comprehensive end-to-end testing (Playwright), WCAG AA accessibility improvements (ARIA attributes, semantic HTML, color contrast), UI component enhancements (animations, error boundary, toast notifications), code splitting optimization, and supporting documentation.

## Changes

| Cohort / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Test Configuration & Infrastructure** <br> `apps/web/playwright.config.ts`, `package.json` | New Playwright configuration with desktop and mobile device profiles (Chromium, iPhone SE, iPhone 12), web server startup, and HTML reporter setup. Added `@playwright/test` dev dependency. |
| **End-to-End Test Suites** <br> `apps/web/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/browser-mcp-tests.spec.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/disabled-states.spec.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/keyboard-navigation.spec.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/mobile-responsiveness.spec.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/screen-reader-aria.spec.ts` | Seven new test suites validating accessibility (ARIA attributes, landmarks, heading hierarchy), keyboard navigation (focus indicators, tab order), disabled states, screen reader compatibility, mobile responsiveness at multiple viewports, and animation/motion preferences. |
| **Error Handling & Notifications** <br> `apps/web/src/components/ErrorBoundary.tsx`, `apps/web/src/components/Toast.tsx` | New class-based ErrorBoundary with fallback UI and reset callback. New Toast system with context-based provider, hooks, auto-dismiss timers, type variants (success/error/info/warning), and ARIA live regions. |
| **App Initialization & Routing** <br> `apps/web/src/App.tsx`, `apps/web/src/main.tsx`, `apps/web/index.html` | Implemented lazy-loading and Suspense for page components; added ErrorBoundary wrapper with navigation reset. Wrapped app with ToastProvider. Added theme-color meta tag; removed hardcoded localhost preconnect. |
| **Page Component Refactors** <br> `apps/web/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx`, `apps/web/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx`, `apps/web/src/pages/CostDashboard.tsx` | ChatPage: converted view-mode toggle to accessible fieldset with radio-styled labels and disabled synthesis when no messages. SearchPage: replaced flat tech-stack filters with checkbox-style chips, selection state tracking, and clear-all functionality. CostDashboard: replaced loader spinner with skeleton UI, added retry button, improved error presentation. |
| **UI Component Accessibility Enhancements** <br> `apps/web/src/components/ApproachCard.tsx`, `apps/web/src/components/BudgetAlerts.tsx`, `apps/web/src/components/ConflictsList.tsx`, `apps/web/src/components/CostBreakdown.tsx`, `apps/web/src/components/CostSummary.tsx`, `apps/web/src/components/FileLink.tsx`, `apps/web/src/components/FileRelationshipSection.tsx`, `apps/web/src/components/RecencyBadge.tsx`, `apps/web/src/components/RelatedFilesPanel.tsx`, `apps/web/src/components/ResultCard.tsx`, `apps/web/src/components/SynthesisView.tsx`, `apps/web/src/components/TrustBadge.tsx` | Systematic accessibility improvements across components: semantic HTML (section/article/nav instead of div), ARIA attributes (labels, live regions, expanded/controls), animation classes, improved focus states, text wrapping for overflow, staggered animations with delays, and icon aria-hidden handling. |
| **Design System & Animations** <br> `apps/web/src/index.css`, `apps/web/tailwind.config.js` | Added utility animation classes (animate-fade-in, animate-slide-down, animate-scale-in) with prefers-reduced-motion support. Updated light-mode color tokens (accent, success, warning, error) to darker shades for WCAG AA contrast compliance. Updated btn-primary hover to bg-blue-700. |
| **Build Optimization** <br> `apps/web/vite.config.ts` | Added build configuration with esbuild minification, CSS code splitting, manual vendor chunking (react-vendor, query-vendor), and optimizeDeps for pre-bundling. |
| **Contrast & Testing Tooling** <br> `scripts/calculate-contrast.js` | New Node.js utility script to compute WCAG contrast ratios across color palettes, validate AA/AAA compliance, and categorize results by component/purpose. |

## Sequence Diagram(s)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as User/<br/>App
    participant App as App.tsx
    participant ErrorBoundary as ErrorBoundary
    participant ToastProvider as ToastProvider
    participant Page as Lazy Page<br/>(w/ Suspense)
    participant Toast as Toast Context

    User->>App: Navigate/Render
    App->>ErrorBoundary: Wrap (error safety)
    ErrorBoundary->>ToastProvider: Wrap (notifications)
    ToastProvider->>Page: Render with lazy-loading
    Note over Page: Suspense fallback<br/>while loading
    Page-->>User: Page content (or error boundary fallback)
    
    rect rgb(200, 220, 240)
    Note over App,Toast: Error Flow
    Page->>ErrorBoundary: Error thrown
    ErrorBoundary->>User: Render fallback UI<br/>(error message + reset button)
    User->>ErrorBoundary: Click reset
    ErrorBoundary->>App: onReset → navigate("/")
    App-->>User: Redirect to home
    end
    
    rect rgb(200, 240, 200)
    Note over ToastProvider,Toast: Toast Flow
    Page->>Toast: useToast().addToast()
    Toast->>ToastProvider: Add to state
    ToastProvider->>User: Render toast<br/>(aria-live polite)
    Note over Toast: Auto-dismiss<br/>timer (if duration set)
    Toast-->>ToastProvider: Remove on timeout/click
    ToastProvider-->>User: Fade out
    end
```

> +    </section>
> ```

<summary>apps/web/e2e/browser-mcp-tests.spec.ts (1)</summary><blockquote>

`286-315`: **Consider visual regression comparison tooling.**

The tests capture screenshots but don't compare them against baselines, so they can't detect visual regressions. They only verify that the page loads.



For true visual regression testing, consider integrating:
1. **Playwright's built-in `toHaveScreenshot()`**:
```typescript
await expect(page).toHaveScreenshot('home-page.png', {
  fullPage: true,
  maxDiffPixels: 100
});
```

2. **Percy** or **Chromatic** for visual diff tracking across commits.

If visual regression isn't a priority, these tests could be renamed to "Smoke Tests" or removed in favor of functional tests.

</blockquote></details>
<details>
<summary>apps/web/src/pages/CostDashboard.tsx (1)</summary><blockquote>

`62-69`: **Retry with page reload is acceptable but consider alternatives.**

The retry button uses `window.location.reload()`, which reloads the entire page and resets all state. For a data-fetching error, this works but isn't ideal.



Consider using React Query's built-in `refetch`:
```diff
-export function CostDashboard() {
-  const { data, isLoading, isError, error } = useQuery({
+const { data, isLoading, isError, error, refetch } = useQuery({
     queryKey: ['cost-summary'],
     queryFn: () => apiClient.getCostSummary(),
     refetchInterval: 30000,
   });

   // In the error button:
   <button
     type="button"
-    onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
+    onClick={() => refetch()}
     className="mt-md btn btn-secondary text-sm"
     aria-label="Retry loading cost data"
   >
```

This retries just the query without reloading the page or losing other state.

</blockquote></details>
<details>
<summary>apps/web/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts (2)</summary><blockquote>

`46-51`: **Conditional execution may hide missing UI.**

Similar to the previous test, the conditional check allows silent passes. If the "Related Files" toggle should always be present, assert its existence. If it's optional UI, add a comment explaining why the conditional is appropriate.

---

`69-80`: **Consider validating heading hierarchy order.**

The test checks that headings exist but doesn't verify they're in logical order (h1 → h2 → h3, not h1 → h3 → h2).



Add hierarchy validation:
```typescript
test('should have proper heading hierarchy', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/');
  await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle');

  const h1 = page.locator('h1');
  expect(await h1.count()).toBeGreaterThan(0);

  // Verify heading order
  const headings = await page.locator('h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6').all();
  expect(headings.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  
  // Check no level is skipped
  const levels = await Promise.all(
    headings.map(h => h.evaluate(el => parseInt(el.tagName[1])))
  );
  let maxLevel = 1;
  for (const level of levels) {
    expect(level).toBeLessThanOrEqual(maxLevel + 1);
    maxLevel = Math.max(maxLevel, level);
  }
});
```

</blockquote></details>

`38-53`: **Test 4 verifies generic disabled button, not specific ones from earlier tests.**

Line 42's `page.locator('button[disabled]').first()` finds any disabled button, which might be different from the search/chat buttons tested earlier. This is fine if the goal is to verify general disabled attribute handling, but consider clarifying the test's intent.



If you want to test the specific buttons:
```typescript
test('disabled buttons should have proper attributes', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/search/test-collection-id');
  await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle');

  const searchButton = page.locator('button[type="submit"]').first();
  const isDisabled = await searchButton.isDisabled();
  expect(isDisabled).toBe(true);

  const ariaDisabled = await searchButton.getAttribute('aria-disabled');
  if (ariaDisabled !== null) {
    expect(ariaDisabled).toBe('true');
  }
});
```
